- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Reject invalid input by raising `BillingError` from `ledgerly.errors` with a stable snake_case code such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity` or `negative_amount`, and pass the offending value as the message.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).

candidate.title: Compute periods via timedelta floor division
candidate.content: Compute subscription period boundaries the same way as `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`: `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` then `n = (at - start) // length` and `start + n * length`.
